name: The Law of Contradiction
source:
A few years before the Fifth Holy Grail War, Bazett Fraga McRemitz is given the order to capture magi who once belonged to the Clock Tower. Anyone standing in her path is allowed to be eliminated.
Bazett heads to the city with his agents lurking in the shadows.
The city where rain never stops.
The lid is open, and battle inevitable.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
第五次圣杯战争前几年，巴泽特·弗拉加·麦克雷米兹奉命抓捕曾经属于钟楼的魔术师。任何阻挡她道路的人都可以被消灭。
巴泽特带着潜伏在阴影中的特工前往这座城市。
雨不停歇的城市。
盖子打开了，战斗不可避免。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
